title: Salen homonuclear and heteronuclear lanthanide(III) complexes with near-infrared (NIR) luminescence

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear salen/acetylacetonate hydroxo cluster with incomplete cubane cores

synthesis.procedure: Homonuclear complex 1 was synthesized by reaction of H2salen with Nd(acac)3·H2O in a 1:1 molar ratio in CH2Cl2/MeOH at ambient temperature (Scheme 1).
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals of 1 were obtained and shown by X-ray crystallography to contain methanol of crystallization (C2/c).

properties.summary: In CH2Cl2, 1 shows ligand-centered UV–vis absorptions at ca. 227, 268 and 300 nm. Solid-state excitation at 415 nm gives characteristic Nd(III) NIR emission assigned to 4F3/2 → 4I9/2 (near 896 nm), 4F3/2 → 4I11/2 (near 1060 nm) and 4F3/2 → 4I13/2 (near 1330 nm). NIR quantum yields could not be measured due to instrumental limitations. H2salen and acac ligands are described as providing efficient energy transfer for Ln(III) sensitization.

measurements.name: UV–vis absorption maxima
measurements.conditions: CH2Cl2 solution; assigned to H2salen and Hacac intraligand transitions

measurements.name: NIR emission bands (Nd3+)
measurements.conditions: solid state, room temperature, λex = 415 nm; 4F3/2 → 4Ij/2 (j = 9, 11, 13)

synthesis.procedure: Heteronuclear complex 2 was prepared by the same procedure as 1 except that two different Ln(acac)3·H2O precursors, Nd(acac)3·H2O and Yb(acac)3·H2O, were used in a 1:1 ratio instead of a single Nd precursor (Scheme 1).

reagents.name: H2salen (N,N′-ethylenebis(salicylideneimine))
reagents.amount: same procedure as 1 (1:1 ligand:metal precursor ratio)

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: X-ray quality crystals; ICP Nd:Yb ≈ 1:1.03; crystallographic Nd:Yb = 1:1 (P21/c).

properties.summary: Complex 2 shows the same three UV–vis absorption sets as 1 (ca. 227, 268, 300 nm). Solid-state excitation at 415 nm produces dual NIR emission from both Nd(III) and Yb(III): Yb emission in the 895–1120 nm range with a sharp main band at 978 nm (2F5/2 → 2F7/2), and Nd bands in the 830–1420 nm range (4F3/2 → 4I9/2, 4I11/2, 4I13/2). Dual emission is attributed to incomplete energy transfer. NIR quantum yields could not be measured due to instrumental limitations.

measurements.name: Yb(III) NIR emission
measurements.conditions: solid state, room temperature, λex = 415 nm; 2F5/2 → 2F7/2

measurements.name: Nd(III) NIR emission range
measurements.conditions: solid state, room temperature, λex = 415 nm; 4F3/2 → 4I9/2, 4I11/2, 4I13/2
